description.zh: 开始时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围0~2147483647。
description.en: The start time, in the format of a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Value range: 0 to 2147483647.

description.zh:
视频设备的设备名称。您可以在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices)的**设备**页面，或调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查看指定产品下设备的**DeviceName**。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the video device. You can view the **DeviceName** of devices under a specified product on the **Devices** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices) or by calling the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>.

description.zh: 结束时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围为0~2147483647，必须大于开始时间**BeginTime**。
description.en: The end time, in the format of a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Value range: 0 to 2147483647. The value must be greater than the value of **BeginTime**.

description.zh:
视频设备的设备ID。可调用[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)接口查询。

><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the video device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation to query the device ID.

><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>.

description.zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。
description.en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** tab of the IoT Platform console.

description.zh:
视频设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。

您可以在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product)的**产品**页面或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)接口，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the video device belongs.

You can view the information about all products under the current instance on the **Products** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product) or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>.

description.zh:
录像类型。可选：

- **0**：连续录像。
- **1**：事件录像。
- **2**：主动录像。
- **4**：本地上云录像。
- **为空**：表示全部录像。
description.en:
The recording type. Valid values:

- **0**: continuous recording.
- **1**: event-triggered recording.
- **2**: active recording.
- **4**: local-to-cloud recording.
- **Empty**: all recordings.

description.zh:
码流类型。可选：

- **0**（默认）：主码流。
- **1**：辅码流。
description.en:
The stream type. Valid values:

- **0** (default): main stream.
- **1**: sub stream.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

- 单次按时间下载时长限制：30分钟。
- 下载时间精度： 下载时间范围精度在10秒内。例如截取选择下载20秒数据， 可能会出现最多下载了30秒数据的情况。
- 单次按时间下载录像文件数量限制：100。
- 下载任务和文件最多保存时长为1天, 超时后可重新下载。
- 单实例最多同时支持下载并发限制为10路（下载完成不计入）。
- 若音视频编码参数发生改变，默认下载的录像为前半段录像。
- 若下载录像时间存在重叠，云端会对数据重叠部分去重。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

- Maximum duration per time-based download: 30 minutes.
- Download time precision: The download time range is accurate to within 10 seconds. For example, if you select 20 seconds of data to download, up to 30 seconds of data may be downloaded.
- Maximum number of recording files per time-based download: 100.
- Download nodes and files are retained for up to 1 day. After the timeout, you can download them again.
- Maximum number of concurrent downloads per instance: 10 (completed downloads are not counted).
- If the audio or video encoding parameters change, the first half of the recording is downloaded by default.
- If the download time ranges overlap, the cloud deduplicates the overlapping data.


## QPS limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can invoke this operation up to 50 times per second (QPS).

> The quota is shared among all Resource Access Management (RAM) users under a single Alibaba Cloud account.
